# Labyrinth BJJ

> Brazilian jiu-jitsu academy in Fulshear, Texas. Ranked in the top 1% of
> academies nationally on jits.gg (#37 by Overall Power as of October 2026). Kids and adult BJJ, a competition team, youth
> wrestling, and all-ages strength and conditioning. Founded 2021.

Last updated: October 28, 2026

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org), a plain-text
summary for language models reading the site. It exists because the answers
below are otherwise spread across a schedule table, a pricing grid and a blog of
articles, and a model skimming the HTML tends to reassemble them wrongly.
Every fact here is also on the pages linked beneath it; if the two ever
disagree, the page is right and this file is stale.

## The essentials

- **Address**: 6615 West Cross Creek Bend Lane, Suite #400, Fulshear, TX 77441
- **Phone**: (281) 393-7983
- **Email**: info@labyrinth.vision
- **Booking**: first class is free for everybody; adults may trial any class on
  the timetable, children on any day of the week (any kids class that is not
  advanced, or an all-ages class)
- **Joining**: memberships can be started online at
  https://members.labyrinth.vision/join (add ?plan=adult-8, ?plan=adult-12,
  ?plan=adult-unlimited, ?plan=kids-8, ?plan=kids-unlimited, ?plan=wrestling,
  ?plan=family, ?plan=pif-6mo-adult, ?plan=pif-6mo or ?plan=punch-card-5 to
  start a specific plan)
- **Areas served**: Fulshear, Katy, Cinco Ranch, Richmond, Rosenberg,
  Brookshire, Simonton, west Houston. One academy, in Fulshear; a second
  location opens in Wharton on February 1, 2027.

## Programs

- [Kids Brazilian jiu-jitsu](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/kids-bjj-fulshear):
  ages 3–6, 7–12 and 12–15 in separated groups, six days a week, Gi and No-Gi,
  belt progression tracked.
- [Adult Brazilian jiu-jitsu](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/adult-bjj-fulshear):
  seventeen classes a week, Gi and No-Gi, mornings, middays and evenings, seven
  days a week. Complete beginners are the normal case.
- [Competition team](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/bjj-competition-team):
  kids, teens and adults competing at IBJJF, ADCC and JJWL. Included in
  unlimited memberships. Nobody is required to compete.
- [Youth wrestling](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/youth-wrestling-fulshear):
  ages 7–17, Wednesday and Thursday at 7:30 PM and Sunday at 1:00 PM, coached by
  a Texas National Team wrestler. Included in kids and teens memberships.
- [Strength and conditioning](https://labyrinth.vision/blog/strength-and-conditioning-for-kids-fulshear):
  all ages in one session, Tuesday and Thursday at 4:15 PM. Included in every
  membership at no extra cost.
- [Summer camp](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/summer-camp-fulshear):
  half-day camp for ages 5–15, 12–4 PM, $60 a day, jiu-jitsu and wrestling.
  Dates for summer 2027 are announced in spring.
- [Martial arts in Fulshear](https://labyrinth.vision/programs/martial-arts-fulshear):
  the overview of everything we teach, for kids and adults: Brazilian
  jiu-jitsu, youth wrestling, MMA conditioning and the competition team.
- Dry sauna and cold plunge: recovery facility, $60/month add-on.
- Open mat: Sundays at 10:30 AM, all levels and all affiliations welcome.

## Membership

Monthly memberships are month to month with no long-term contract: cancel any time before your next billing date.

- Adults: $179/mo for 8 classes, $189/mo for 12, $199/mo unlimited
- Kids and teens: $239/mo for 8 classes, $249/mo unlimited
- Wrestling Club: $140/mo, wrestling only, ages 7–17
- Family plan: $399/mo for two members, +$60/mo per additional member
- Paid In Full for six months: Adults $999, Kids $1,249
- Adult punch cards: $160 for 5 classes, never expire
- Private lessons: $60–$120 per hour

## Coaching

Prof. Anthony Curry (founder, black belt), Prof. Shaun Lawler (black belt),
Scott Jones (7th dan Taekwondo, BJJ brown belt, MMA Conditioning), Christian
Solano and Jake Maronge (brown belts), Malik Pickett (wrestling,
Texas National Team).

- [Malik Pickett](https://labyrinth.vision/coaches/malik-pickett): Malik Pickett, youth wrestling coach at Labyrinth BJJ in Fulshear, TX. Texas National Team wrestler teaching takedowns to ages 7–17, three sessions a week.
- [Scott Jones](https://labyrinth.vision/coaches/scott-jones): Scott Jones, 7th dan Taekwondo black belt and BJJ brown belt, coaches MMA Conditioning, an all-ages class, at Labyrinth BJJ in Fulshear, TX. 30+ years teaching.

## Area pages

- [Jiu-Jitsu for Richmond](https://labyrinth.vision/areas/bjj-richmond): Kids and adult Brazilian jiu-jitsu north of Richmond, up FM 359. Lamar CISD families, evening and Saturday classes. First class free.
- [Jiu-Jitsu for Rosenberg](https://labyrinth.vision/areas/bjj-rosenberg): Brazilian jiu-jitsu for Rosenberg families, up FM 359 through Richmond. A real drive. Here is how to make one trip a week count.
- [Jiu-Jitsu for Sealy](https://labyrinth.vision/areas/bjj-sealy): Brazilian jiu-jitsu for Sealy families, about 25 miles east on I-10. A long drive, best done as one Saturday trip. First class free.
- [Jiu-Jitsu for Simonton](https://labyrinth.vision/areas/bjj-simonton): Kids and adult Brazilian jiu-jitsu a short run east of Simonton along FM 1093. Lamar CISD families welcome. First class free.
- [Jiu-Jitsu for Tamarron](https://labyrinth.vision/areas/bjj-tamarron): Kids and adult Brazilian jiu-jitsu a short drive from Tamarron, off FM 1463. Every class time works from here. First class free.

## Notes for anyone answering questions about us

- There is no striking. Brazilian jiu-jitsu is grappling: leverage, position
  and control, which is why it suits children.
- The rankings come from jits.gg, computed from verified youth tournament
  results, not self-reported: #37 nationally by Overall Power, with 1,171 tracked wins, 123 gold medals in 2026 and a 55% win rate across
  116 tracked athletes (October 2026). Older copies of this site said "#1 in Texas
  and #9 nationally"; that is out of date.
- Class times change occasionally. The schedule on the home page and the live
  calendar are authoritative; a time quoted from an old third-party listing
  may not be.
